title: Key mapping leaves Alt or Ctrl active after idle wake

status.label: Confirm stuck modifier after idle on current release
status.detail: The report describes a random Alt/Ctrl stuck state after waking from idle on PowerToys 0.93.0, but has no follow-up or diagnostics.

judgment.rationale: The reporter says left Alt is mapped to left Ctrl and Insert to Delete because the physical Ctrl/Delete keys do not work. After idle wake, pressing Alt can register as Alt+Ctrl or leave Alt active, causing Esc to minimize windows. The report is specific but from 0.93.0 and has no current-version confirmation or diagnostic capture.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.93.0 from Microsoft Store on Windows 11.
The two mappings are Insert to Delete and left Alt to left Ctrl.
The issue reportedly occurs randomly after the display goes dark from idle without a lock screen.
No comments, current-version confirmation, or diagnostic attachment are present.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the issue persists on current stable and, if it does, request a fresh /bugreport captured immediately after the stuck modifier occurs.

fix_assessment.rationale: If the problem persists after idle wake, Keyboard Manager may fail to reconcile modifier key state across display or input-device idle transitions. A current diagnostic capture is needed to distinguish a remapping engine issue from the physically failing keys or a device-state change.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore modifier state after waking from idle
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The remapping engine may retain or synthesize an inconsistent Alt/Ctrl state when input resumes after idle, especially when the physical Ctrl key is unavailable. The report does not identify which transition causes the stuck state.
plan: Confirm the issue on current stable and capture a fresh PowerToys diagnostic immediately after reproduction.
Compare engine and input state before idle and after the display wakes.
Trace how remapped modifiers are released or reconciled across the observed idle transition.
Correct the confirmed state handling and add regression coverage for wake/resume with an active remap.
verification: Verify left Alt produces only the configured left Ctrl mapping after idle wake.
Verify Alt and Ctrl are released when the key is released and Esc no longer minimizes windows unexpectedly.
Repeat multiple idle/wake cycles with both reported mappings active.

confidence.rationale: The post-idle symptom and mapping are concrete, but recurrence on current builds and the failing input transition are unknown.

issue_context.summary: After idle wake, left Alt mapped to left Ctrl reportedly acts as Alt+Ctrl or remains stuck, causing later keypresses such as Esc to minimize windows.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.93.0 from Microsoft Store on Windows 11.
Insert is mapped to Delete and left Alt to left Ctrl because the physical Delete/Ctrl keys do not work.
The issue reportedly occurs randomly after the display goes dark from idle without a lock screen.
No comments or diagnostics are present.
inferences: The symptom may involve modifier state after idle/resume, but the report does not rule out the failing physical keys or a device/driver transition.
issue_context.analysis: The report provides a useful setup but not a deterministic trigger. First confirm current behavior and request a fresh /bugreport only if it still reproduces; do not request raw logs separately.
initial_investigation: Read the full report, mapping configuration, idle condition, environment, labels, state, and comments.
No linked fix or related issue was identified.

information_gaps.information: Whether the issue still occurs on current stable and a fresh PowerToys diagnostic captured immediately after the modifier becomes stuck
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is from 0.93.0 and the event is random; current-version evidence is needed to identify the active input-state failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On current stable, repeat the mappings through an idle/wake cycle. If Alt or Ctrl becomes stuck, add a comment containing /bugreport immediately after the reproduction.

reproduce.title: Verify remapped modifier state after idle wake
prerequisites: A keyboard with the reported physical Ctrl/Delete key problem
setup: Map left Alt to left Ctrl.
steps: Allow the display to go dark from idle without locking Windows.
Wake the display and press left Alt as a single key.
Check whether Alt or Ctrl remains active and whether Esc unexpectedly minimizes the current window.
reproduce.expected_result: Left Alt should produce only the configured left Ctrl mapping and release normally after key-up.
